asunto: New: FLUX 3 Image Klein, plus updates to FLUX 3 Video in 2K and 4K
cuerpo:
Get early access to the improved FLUX Video Upscale, a week before its public launch, at about half its old price.

NEW: FLUX 3 IMAGE KLEIN · UPDATED: FLUX 3 VIDEO, FLUX VIDEO UPSCALE

FLUX 3 Image Klein, and two updates for video

You can now generate and edit images on OpenRouter with FLUX 3 Image Klein, Black Forest Labs' new open-weights model.

FLUX 3 Video can now render 2K and 4K clips directly.

The improved FLUX Video Upscale can take a clip from any video model up to 4K, at about half its old price. You can try it now in early access for the next week.

See FLUX 3 Image Klein:
https://openrouter.ai/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein?utm_campaign=101626_bfl-launch_image-video-180d&utm_content=klein-cta-plain#playground

New model
OPEN-WEIGHTS IMAGES WITH FLUX 3 IMAGE KLEIN

You can use it to:

- generate from a text prompt, including at native 4K
- generate and edit from several reference images
- set composition and layout with bounding boxes
- apply the style of a reference image to a new one
- render text in an image, or edit text that's already there

Black Forest Labs calls it the most capable open-weights image model, with frontier quality and the customization and speed of open weights. At 5.6B parameters it runs on a single consumer GPU. It keeps the control features of the larger FLUX 3 Image model.

FLUX 3 Image Klein is priced from $0.008 per image. Any Klein still can be the first frame of a FLUX 3 Video clip, and the image-to-video guide shows how:
https://openrouter.ai/docs/cookbook/video-generation/image-to-video?utm_campaign=101626_bfl-launch_image-video-180d&utm_content=guide-i2v-plain

Update
FLUX 3 VIDEO, NOW IN 2K AND 4K

The new 2K and 4K settings keep the same shot and render it on a larger canvas, so you can pick the resolution your project needs without rewriting the prompt. Black Forest Labs puts a 5-second 4K clip at about two minutes to render.

FLUX 3 Video makes clips of up to 20 seconds with sound. It writes the dialogue, sound effects and background audio along with the picture, and it lip-syncs in more than a dozen languages. You can start from whatever you have:

- a text prompt, from a single line to a full shot list
- a first frame, a last frame or both, and it fills in the motion between them
- an existing clip, which it continues with the same camera, movement and dialogue

In Black Forest Labs' own human-rater evaluation, FLUX 3 Video beat the leading video models on text-to-video by a solid margin. On image-to-video it tied the strongest model and beat the rest.

[Image] A frame from a FLUX 3 Video clip made from a one-sentence text prompt.

See FLUX 3 Video:
https://openrouter.ai/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video?utm_campaign=101626_bfl-launch_image-video-180d&utm_content=video-plain

Update · Early access
TAKE ANY CLIP TO 4K

The improved FLUX Video Upscale is live on OpenRouter in early access, a week before its public launch, at about half its old price. If you already call it, your requests use the new version with no code changes.

FLUX Video Upscale works on footage from whatever model you already use. That matters because 21 of the 27 video models on OpenRouter output 1080p or less. Send it a clip of up to 20 seconds and choose how much bigger you want it, from 1.5 to 3 times. A 720p clip at 3x or a 1080p clip at 2x comes back in 4K. You keep the original length, aspect ratio and audio track.

Black Forest Labs built it for the things general-purpose upscalers tend to get wrong, like smudged faces and the grid pattern that shows up on water and grass. You pick one of two modes, depending on whether the details have to stay exactly as they are:

- Precise sharpens what's already there. Use it for faces, products and brand assets, where nothing should change.
- Creative restores and adds fine detail. It suits generated footage, textures and scenery, and a short prompt steers what it adds.

[Image] The same frame before and after FLUX Video Upscale, run on OpenRouter: a 1080p clip from another video model, upscaled 2x to 4K in Precise mode.

TRY THE UPSCALER

Here's a request you can run as is. Swap in the URL of your own clip:

    curl https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/videos \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{
        "model": "black-forest-labs/flux-video-upscale",
        "prompt": "A city street at dusk",
        "input_references": [{
          "type": "video_url",
          "video_url": { "url": "https://example.com/your-clip.mp4" }
        }],
        "upscale_factor": 2,
        "creativity": 0
      }'

Set creativity to 0 for Precise or 1 for Creative. The call returns a job ID that you poll until the video is ready. The video generation guide covers each step:
https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/video-generation?utm_campaign=101626_bfl-launch_image-video-180d&utm_content=guide-video-plain

PRICING AT 4K

- FLUX Video Upscale, Precise: $0.29 per second of 4K output
- FLUX Video Upscale, Creative: $0.415 per second of 4K output
- FLUX 3 Video, text or image to video: $0.41 per second of 4K output
- FLUX 3 Video, continuing a clip: $0.45 per second of 4K output

Upscale prices per megapixel-second are now $0.035 for Precise, from $0.075, and $0.05 for Creative, from $0.105. Prices at other resolutions are on each model's page.

The OpenRouter Team
